description: The same locked profile and per-effect `routing: high` pin as profile-routing-pin-under-lock, but with `routing.respect_explicit: false`: the router now overrides the lock too, so meta.model becomes the natural scored band's model ("low"'s model-small), model_reason: "router" -- not the pinned "high" row, since the pin's own gate (`if not explicit and override is not None`) is still skipped while the effect is explicit (locked); only `route_model`'s own deference to that explicit flag is switched off by `respect_explicit: false`, and that only ever consults the score, never the pin.
